content.introduction: BlackRock's 2026 Fall Investment Directions highlight AI-driven volatility, the impact of midterms, a steepening yield curve, and strategies for building diversified portfolios amid intensifying competition for capital. The report emphasizes managing AI concentration, building resilient portfolios, and finding income opportunities across markets. It favors staying invested while being selective about portfolio risk. The Q4 Global Investment Outlook underscores a constructive stance on risk, favoring AI bottlenecks, shorter-term bonds, and opportunities beyond asset class labels. The sources don't provide a definitive answer to specific queries not directly addressed.

Read the full Investment Directions  Read the full Investment Directions

# Scarcity vs. abundance

September 15, 2026 | Global government bond yields have broken higher as sovereign borrowing competes with private financing needs led by AI. Yet equities are resilient, supported by solid AI-led earnings growth. We stay constructive on risk but are increasingly selective, favoring AI bottlenecks, shorter-term bonds and opportunities beyond asset class labels.
